title: Non-mosaic Down syndrome
summary: Non-mosaic Down syndrome (chromosome 21 trisomy or chromosome 21 translocation), documented by A) a karyotype report signed by a physician (or unsigned report plus physician statement), B) a physician's report of chromosome 21 trisomy/translocation consistent with prior karyotype analysis plus distinctive Down syndrome features, or C) a physician's report stating Down syndrome with distinctive features and evidence demonstrating function consistent with non-mosaic Down syndrome.

children.criterion: A laboratory report of karyotype analysis signed by a physician, OR both a laboratory report of karyotype analysis not signed by a physician AND a statement by a physician that the claimant has Down syndrome (see 10.00C1)

A physician's report stating chromosome 21 trisomy or chromosome 21 translocation consistent with prior karyotype analysis, with distinctive facial or other physical features of Down syndrome (see 10.00C2a)

A physician's report stating that the claimant has Down syndrome with the distinctive facial or other physical features AND evidence demonstrating that the claimant functions at a level consistent with non-mosaic Down syndrome (see 10.00C2b)
